title: A Delsarte Linear Programming Approach to the Erdős--Falconer Distance Problem over Finite Fields
summary: We introduce a Delsarte linear programming approach to the finite field Erdős--Falconer distance problem. Let \(q\) be an odd prime power, let \(n\) be even, and let \(Q\) be a non-degenerate quadratic form on \(\mathbb{F}_q^n\). For \(E\subset \mathbb{F}_q^n\), define \[ Δ_Q(E)=\{Q(x-y):\ x,y\in E\}. \] We prove that, for every fixed \(0 0\) and \(q_α\) such that if \(q\ge q_α\) and $|E|\ge C_αq^{\frac n2+\frac13},$ then \[ |Δ_Q(E)|>1+α(q-1). \] In particular, \(Δ_Q(E)\) contains a positive proportion of the elements of \(\mathbb{F}_q\), and hence \(|Δ_Q(E)|\gg q\).
